measured: largest world-space dimension of each deployed .glb, through the site's own CCViewer in a real browser
compared_to: largest published dimension (length/beam/height) from the Fleetyards record for the same ship
note: This audits the 219 models that were ALREADY here before the 2026-08-27 import. The 19 imported ones are covered by checks/_verify_model_scale.mjs and all sit at ratio 1.000.
caveat: A ratio away from 1 means the model and the published figure disagree. Usually the model is wrong. It is not always the model - see the Eclipse and Defender, where the published figure looks like the wrong one.
